senses.gloss:
बिम्ब बिम्ब, or विम्ब,
 I. m. and n.
 1. The disk of the sun or moon, Pañc. 162, 23.
 2. A reflected form, an image, Megh. 48.
 3. Reflection, Utt. Rāmac. 35, 18.
 4. The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha.
 II. n., and f. बा or बी, A cucurbitaceous plant with red fruit, Momordica monadelpha, Pañc. i. d. 225.
 --Comp.

बिम्बित बिम्बित, i. e. बिम्ब + इत, also विम्बित, adj.
 1. Reflected, Rājat. 5, 343.
 2. Pictured.
 --Comp.

बिम्बोष्ठ बिम्बोष्ठ, and बिम्भौष्ठ बिम्बौष्ठ, or विम्ब्˚, i. e. बिम्ब-ओष्ठ,
 I. m. A bimba-like lip, i. e. red as the Bimba fruit, Kathās. 4, 8 (corr. p. 146 A, 2 bel.).
 II. adj., f. ठा and ठी, Having lips like the Bimba fruit, redlipped.
